name: Argentina 2032
description: A rearmed Argentina in 2032, fictional: the F-16s bought from Denmark, the A-4AR Fightinghawks, Mi-171 and Huey transport, and short-range air defence bought from China. Stock DCS units plus the community A-4E Skyhawk mod. The F-16A stands in for the F-16AM/BM, the A-4E for the A-4AR, the Mi-17 for the Mi-171E, the Leopard 1A3 for the TAM, the Marder for the VCTP, the C-130J-30 for the C-130H and the Castle class for the Gowind patrol ships.
